1 (Currently amended): A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the unique identifier is not solely associated with the package.

4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising: searching a data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier, wherein the data store is not limited to a single database.

6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and converting the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form, wherein the first form is not restricted to a specific data format.

8 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises at least one of when a next dose of the product is to be taken, when a previous dose of the product was taken, and if a dose of the product is to be taken, wherein the at least use information is not limited to a specific dosage schedule.

9 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving user information regarding use of the product from a user, wherein the user information is not limited to a specific type of input.

19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying the user, wherein the second unique identifier is not limited to a specific format.
